findings.summary: Schedule day status uses a bespoke Material Chip instead of the shared MobileStatusPill status widget.
findings.fix: Replace `trailing: Chip(label: Text(_dayStatus(day.dayStatus)))` with `trailing: MobileStatusPill(day.dayStatus)` (import mobile_widgets.dart), keeping status styling consistent with the rest of the app.

findings.summary: Correction status uses a bespoke Material Chip instead of MobileStatusPill, and _status re-implements label mapping (pending/approved/rejected/cancelled) that MobileStatusPill already provides.
findings.fix: Replace `trailing: Chip(label: Text(_status(item.status)))` with `trailing: MobileStatusPill(item.status)`; MobileStatusPill already maps pending/approved/rejected/cancelled to colored pills, so the local _status helper becomes redundant for display.

findings.summary: Section titles are hand-rolled titleLarge Texts instead of the shared MobileSectionHeader.
findings.fix: Replace both bespoke title Texts (lines 40-45 and 79-84) with `MobileSectionHeader(title: 'جدول العمل القادم')` / `MobileSectionHeader(title: 'طلبات التصحيح')` for consistent section styling across pages.

findings.summary: Error state is a bare centered Text with no icon, no brand, and no retry affordance, inconsistent with a polished error state.
findings.fix: Wrap the error in a centered column with an error icon (Icons.error_outline colored with colorScheme.error), the message, and a FilledButton/TextButton that calls `ref.invalidate(myAttendanceServicesProvider)` to retry.

findings.summary: Empty-state cards for schedule and corrections are plain text-only cards with no icon or visual treatment, reading as unstyled placeholders.
findings.fix: Give both empty cards (lines 47-53 and 86-92) a centered icon (e.g. Icons.event_busy_outlined / Icons.edit_calendar_outlined) above the message using onSurfaceVariant color for a consistent empty-state look.

findings.summary: Correction leading icon does not color-differentiate approved/rejected/pending, so the status cue relies only on icon shape and reads flat.
findings.fix: Color the leading Icon by status using the shared status palette (green 0xFF0F9F6E for approved, red 0xFFDC3D4B for rejected, amber/onSurfaceVariant for pending) to reinforce status visually.

findings.summary: The schedule day CircleAvatar relies on default avatar theming which may not read against the card in dark mode.
findings.fix: Set explicit `backgroundColor: colorScheme.primaryContainer` and `foregroundColor: colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer` on the CircleAvatar so the day badge reads consistently in both light and dark themes.

findings.summary: The date-picker ListTile trailing calendar icon has no tooltip/Semantics label.
findings.fix: Add a Tooltip or Semantics label (e.g. 'اختيار يوم العمل') on the trailing calendar_month_outlined icon so the tap-to-pick-date affordance is announced.
